item.title: ‘Few will mourn’ Ayatollah’s death in US-Israeli strikes, says Defence Secretary
item.description: Iranian state TV confirmed the death of 86-year-old Mr Khamenei early on Sunday as Iran continued to retaliate to the attacks by firing missiles at Gulf neighbours and Israel.

item.title: Foreign Office urges UK nationals in Israel to register online for updates
item.description: The advice on the FCDO website also warned British nationals in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar and Kuwait to “immediately shelter in place”

item.title: Green Party leader condemns attacks on Iran
item.description: He told the BBC’s Sunday With Laura Kuenssberg programme: “We’ve seen what I would say is an illegal and unprovoked attack/;

item.title: UK declines to say whether US-Israeli strikes on Iran are legal
item.description: Defence Secretary John Healey warned on Sunday that Iranian retaliation could put UK personnel and allies at risk

item.title: UK flights to and from Middle East remain suspended until at least Monday
item.description: Qatar Airways, Etihad Airways, Emirates and others have suspended all operations

item.title: Woman killed and dozens injured as Tel Aviv hit by Iranian missiles
item.description: The victim, a foreign caregiver, had failed to reach a bomb shelter before impact

item.title: Half of Iran’s missile launchers destroyed in first 24 hours
item.description: Joint US-Israel assault dismantled 200 launchers, crippled explosives production and halted manufacture of 1,500 ballistic missiles, military official tells Jewish News

item.title: Death toll from an Iranian missile strike on Beit Shemesh rises to nine
item.description: The missile hit a residential neighbourhood in the city, flattening part of a housing block and sending shockwaves through the surrounding streets

item.title: Three US soldiers killed in Middle East
item.description: No details have been announced about where or under what conditions the deaths took place

item.title: Sirens, shelters and an empty Old City: Jerusalem rattled by war with Iran
item.description: Israel’s capital is quiet on a typical Shabbat. But the mood was starkly different last weekend
